headlines: MIAMI BEACH HONORS VETERANS WITH BETSY ORB PROJECTIONS
OCEAN DRIVE LANDMARK LIGHTS UP FOR VETERANS
ICONIC SOUTH BEACH ORB PROJECTING LETTERS TO HEROES
draft.article:
The City of Miami Beach and VFW Post 3559 are lighting up South Beach ahead of Veterans Day. From Nov. 7 through Nov. 10, electronic letters and video tributes will illuminate The Betsy Orb, the spherical skybridge connecting The Betsy Hotel at 1440 Ocean Drive to the former Carlton Hotel.

Events begin Saturday, Nov. 7, at 5:30 p.m. with a live bugler outside The Betsy playing "Retreat," broadcast simultaneously at Lincoln Road and Pennsylvania Avenue, plus 73rd Street and Ocean Terrace in North Beach.

The Betsy will also host documentary screenings alongside a special presentation. U.S. Southern Command Col. Wesley Hales will award replacement medals to Miami Beach Vietnam War veteran USAF Sgt. James E. Anderson.

draft.article: South Florida law enforcement officers rolled out on September 5 for the ninth annual Mystic Force Foundation first responder parade. The vehicle procession began at Nicklaus Children's Hospital in South Miami and traveled north to Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital in Hollywood to lift the spirits of pediatric cancer patients. Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office Miami Lakes District Deputy Robin Amador took part in the event, motivated by the loss of his cousin and a colleague's child to cancer. Participating agencies showcased cruisers, vintage vehicles, and special cars featuring decals, alongside responders dressed as characters such as Batman and Spider-Man. Young patients and their families enjoyed the multi-agency spectacle from sidewalks and hospital windows.

headlines: MIAMI BEACH RESIDENT TO CAST FIRST BALLOT AFTER 16 YEARS
FIRST-TIME VOTER AT 48 IN MIAMI BEACH
WHY A MIAMI BEACH CITIZEN WAITED 16 YEARS TO VOTE
draft.article:
Miami Beach resident Nicolas Mantovani is preparing to cast his first ballot in the November 3, 2026 midterm elections. At 48 years old, Mantovani has been a naturalized United States citizen since 2010 but has never taken part in an election.

Mantovani arrived from Argentina during childhood and lived under a student visa and permanent residency before gaining citizenship. For sixteen years, hesitation about the electoral process and doubts regarding whether an individual vote mattered kept him away from the polls.

Now actively researching candidates, he wants to shape his local community and encourage younger generations to make their voices heard.

items.title: Miami-Dade County is experiencing a population decline

headlines: MIAMI-DADE RANKS THIRD NATIONWIDE FOR POPULATION LOSS
THOUSANDS OF LOCALS ARE PACKING UP AND LEAVING
WHY ARE SO MANY RESIDENTS LEAVING PARADISE BEHIND
draft.article: Miami-Dade County lost 10,115 residents between July 2024 and July 2025, recording the third-largest population drop among all counties nationwide. The local population slipped from 2.81 million to 2.80 million people. Domestic departures fueled the shift. Over 72,000 more residents relocated to other parts of the country than moved into the county, marking the highest domestic migration loss in Florida. While about 54,200 international newcomers arrived, that pace dropped from more than 78,000 during the prior year. Living expenses remain a primary strain across the region. Sixty percent of middle-income renters pay over 30 percent of their income toward housing, while purchasing a typical home now demands almost double the median household income.

items.desc: Dade County was created on February 4, 1836, named after Major Francis L. Dade and the Miami River. That same year, Fort Dallas was built and served as a military base during the Second Seminole War.

headlines: DADE COUNTY WAS OFFICIALLY CREATED ON FEBRUARY 4, 1836
OUR LOCAL ORIGINS IN 1836
HOW OUR COMMUNITY GOT ITS START DURING HISTORIC 1836
draft.article: Dade County officially came into existence on February 4, 1836, marking a pivotal moment in our local history. The newly formed territory was named in honor of Major Francis L. Dade and the Miami River. That exact year brought further historic developments to our area. Fort Dallas was constructed in 1836, establishing a prominent post near the water. The site operated as an active military base during the Second Seminole War, shaping the early defense and territorial presence across the region during that foundational era.
